question: Should CodexBar maintain prompt-free Chrome local-storage discovery of DeepSeek Platform bearer tokens and use them with undocumented dashboard endpoints?
rationale: Tests can validate implementation mechanics, but only repository ownership can accept the long-term browser credential, privacy, upstream stability, and support boundary.

options.title: Approve bounded browser enrichment
options.body: Accept Chrome-only, in-memory session discovery with strict origin scoping, redacted diagnostics, hard timeouts, balance-only fallback, and a non-destructive legacy migration.

options.title: Require explicit Platform token
options.body: Support detailed usage only when the user supplies a Platform token through an explicit configuration or environment path, avoiding automatic browser discovery.

options.title: Retain balance-only support
options.body: Decline the private endpoint contract and keep DeepSeek limited to its documented API-key balance endpoint.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded browser enrichment
recommendation.body: Accept Chrome-only, in-memory session discovery with strict origin scoping, redacted diagnostics, hard timeouts, balance-only fallback, and a non-destructive legacy migration.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository-level ownership is needed to accept the browser credential and undocumented endpoint support boundary.
